description: Read OpenZeppelin audit reports and respond to their issues from Claude.
long_description:
Reads the audit reports of your project on audits.openzeppelin.com, and can submit or remove your team's official response to an issue.

Setup:
1. Install Google Chrome if it is not on this Mac, and sign in at https://audits.openzeppelin.com in it.
2. Open your project there and copy the part of the address after audits.openzeppelin.com/ (for example your-org). Paste it into this extension's Organization setting.
3. Ask Claude, for example: "list our OpenZeppelin audits". The extension reads your session from Chrome. The first time, macOS may ask whether to allow access to "Chrome Safe Storage": click Always Allow.

When the session expires, sign in again in Chrome and retry. Submitting or removing a response always asks you first.
